intro: This is the old core of Shillong. It brings together Police Bazar, the city's main commercial hub, and three long-settled residential neighbourhoods to its west and north: Mawkhar, Jaiaw and Mawprem. Their shared history goes back to 1878, when the village of Mawkhar, which then covered Jaiaw and parts of Jhalupara and Mawprem, was brought into the new municipality. Each of the four is now a ward of the Shillong Municipal Board, alongside Jail Road, and together they run from the shopping streets out to Garikhana and up towards Mawlai.

Housing here is a mix of flats above shopfronts in the commercial streets and older family houses in narrow, sloping lanes behind them. That shapes a tutor's first visit: a building name and floor matter in Police Bazar, while in Jaiaw or Upper and Lower Mawprem the lane name and a landmark do the work. Shillong has no rail link, so tutors come by shared taxi, city bus or two-wheeler, and the Jhalupara bus stand on GS Road sits beside Mawkhar. Market roads near Iewduh are crowded by day, which is why evening slots are the common choice.

Because the four neighbourhoods sit so close together, a tutor who lives in one of them can usually teach in any other, and many tutors from elsewhere in the city pass through the centre anyway. NXTutors starts every shortlist with tutors living in the zone, then those who travel here, then the rest of Shillong, then online tutors. A family receives two or three matched names, sees each tutor's fee before booking, and takes the first class as a free demo. If the fit is wrong later, switching to another tutor costs nothing.
faqs: Which neighbourhoods make up the Police Bazar & Jaiaw zone?

Four: Police Bazar, Jaiaw, Mawkhar and Mawprem. Police Bazar is the commercial hub, while the other three are long-settled residential areas that grew from the old village of Mawkhar, taken into the municipality in 1878. Each has its own area page on NXTutors showing tutors nearby.
Is a central zone like this easy for tutors from other parts of Shillong?

Yes, in most cases. Shared taxis and city buses from across Shillong converge on the centre, and the Jhalupara bus stand on GS Road is beside Mawkhar. The catch is daytime crowding near the markets, so a slot starting once shops begin to close keeps the tutor on time.
What details help a tutor find a home in the central wards?

It depends on the home. For a flat above a shop in Police Bazar or Mawkhar, give the building name, floor and a phone number. For a house in a Jaiaw or Mawprem lane, give the lane, a landmark, and whether the final stretch is on foot.
Will we know the tutor's fee before the demo in this zone?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. On NXTutors you see each matched tutor's own rate on the profile before the free demo is booked.

intro: The southern and higher side of the city forms this zone: Laban, Lawsohtun beside it, and Upper Shillong on the slopes above the main town. Laban was the second of the two villages taken into the municipality in 1878 and then covered Lumparing, Madan Laban, Kench's Trace and Rilbong, names that families still use for their part of it. Laban, Lumparing and Kenches Trace are municipal wards today. Lawsohtun is a separate town of the metropolitan region next to Laban, while Upper Shillong takes in hillside villages such as Nonglyer and Laitmynsaw.

Two kinds of home tutoring meet here. In Laban and Lawsohtun, homes sit along hill roads and the sloping lanes off them, with a local market near the Last Stop area, and shared taxis and city buses run in through Bara Bazar and the Rilbong side. Upper Shillong is more spread out and further from the central wards, so fewer tutors live close by and families often pair a home tutor for younger children with online lessons for senior subjects. Weather changes quickly at height, and in heavy rain or mist an earlier start is kinder to a travelling tutor.

For a family in Laban, the nearest tutors usually live in Laban's own parts or in Lawsohtun; for Upper Shillong, the pool widens sooner. NXTutors follows that order: tutors in the zone, then those willing to travel here, then the rest of Shillong, then online tutors for subjects that are hard to staff. Each request brings two or three matched tutors with their fees on view, and the first class is a free demo. Students preparing for MBOSE's SSLC or HSSLC, or for CBSE, can name the board in the request.
faqs: Which parts of the city fall in the Laban & Upper Shillong zone?

Laban with its parts, Lumparing, Madan Laban, Kench's Trace and Rilbong, plus Lawsohtun alongside and Upper Shillong on the higher slopes, including Nonglyer and Laitmynsaw. Laban, Lawsohtun and Upper Shillong each have their own area page on NXTutors, listing the tutors who live or travel nearest to them.
Is it harder to find a home tutor in Upper Shillong than in Laban?

Usually, yes. Upper Shillong sits well above the main town with homes spread across the hillside, so fewer tutors live nearby. Families there often keep a home tutor for younger children and use an online tutor for senior subjects, while Laban draws easily on tutors from its own parts.
How do tutors travel into Laban and Lawsohtun?

Mostly by shared taxi or city bus through Bara Bazar or the Rilbong side, or on a two-wheeler. The market near the Last Stop area makes a good meeting point for a first visit, and in heavy rain families should allow a little extra time on the hill roads.
Can a family in this zone change tutor if the first one does not suit?

Yes, at no cost. NXTutors offers two or three matched tutors, the first class with your choice is a free demo, and you can ask for a different tutor later without paying anything to switch. The new shortlist again starts with tutors closest to your home.

intro: This is the largest zone on NXTutors in Shillong, running east from Malki through Laitumkhrah to Nongthymmai, Rynjah, Umpling and Madanrting. Laitumkhrah, named after the Umkhrah river that rises there, is often called the heart of Shillong and is known as a centre of education with many schools. Malki, which includes Dhankheti and Risa Colony, lies between it and the city centre. Nongthymmai, whose name means the new village, includes Jingkieng and Motinagar, and Rynjah, Umpling and Madanrting continue the residential spread out along the roads beyond, each with its own bus stops and lanes.

Roads tie the zone together: the national highway through Shillong passes along Malki and Nongthymmai, three roads lead from Laitumkhrah to Happy Valley, Umpling and New Colony, and a road via Goraline joins Laitumkhrah to Rynjah. Bus stops such as Dhankheti, Jingkieng, Pohkseh, Lapalang, Mawblei and Madanrting give tutors without a vehicle clear meeting points. Homes range from newer flats in Laitumkhrah to houses in climbing lanes and numbered bylanes further out, where a landmark matters. School opening and closing times bring the heaviest traffic, so evening slots tend to run more smoothly.

With neighbourhoods strung along connected roads, a tutor living in Laitumkhrah or Nongthymmai can often reach Malki, Rynjah or Umpling in the same evening. NXTutors uses that geography when it shortlists: tutors in the zone first, then those who travel in, then the rest of Shillong, then online tutors. Families compare two or three names, see each fee on the profile before booking, and start with a free demo class. A family in Madanrting or Umpling, at the outer end, may also find a blend of home and online lessons works well.
faqs: Which localities are in the Laitumkhrah & Rynjah zone?

Six: Laitumkhrah, Malki, Nongthymmai, Rynjah, Umpling and Madanrting. They run east from the edge of the city centre at Malki to Madanrting on the road out of Shillong, and each has its own NXTutors area page listing the tutors nearest to it, so families can see who is close before sending a request.
Why does school traffic matter for tuition slots in Laitumkhrah?

Because Laitumkhrah is known as a centre of education, with many schools close together. Roads are busiest at opening and closing times, so a tuition slot that begins later in the evening lets a tutor travelling from Malki, Rynjah or Nongthymmai arrive on time and start the lesson without a rush.
How do tutors find homes in Rynjah or Umpling?

By bylane number and a landmark. Many Rynjah lanes are numbered, and Umpling homes often sit some way off the main road, so families share the bylane, a nearby bus stop such as Lapalang or Pohkseh, and whether the tutor should come to the gate or be met at the stop.
Does NXTutors only suggest tutors who live in this zone?

No, it starts there and widens if needed. Tutors living in the zone come first, then those who travel here, then others across Shillong, and finally online tutors. You always get two or three matched names, each fee is shown before booking, and the first class is a free demo.

intro: Shillong's northern and north-eastern side makes up this zone: Mawlai, one of the city's historic neighbourhoods and a large town in its own right, Pynthorumkhrah, and Nongmynsong between Pynthorumkhrah and Rynjah. Mawlai is made up of several localities, among them Mawlai Mawiong, Mawlai Nongpdeng, Mawlai Mawdatbaki and Kynton Massar, and it meets Jaiaw on the city side. Pynthorumkhrah includes Langkyrding and lies next to Mawpat, Shyiap and Umshing-Mawkynroh, while Nongmynsong borders Golf Links, Itshyrwat and Lyndhurst Estate. A district road passes through Nongmynsong, and taxis and buses from the city centre run out along this side of town, which is how most tutors without a vehicle arrive.

Homes across these three neighbourhoods are mostly on slopes and in lanes off the main roads, often reached by steps, so a tutor needs the locality name, a landmark and to know whether a car or only a two-wheeler can reach the gate. Bus stops make dependable meeting points: Mawiong, Nonglum and Mawlai Pump in Mawlai, Laitlum, Umkdait and Itshyrwat around Pynthorumkhrah, and the Nongmynsong and Umkdait stops on the main road. Crossing the city at busy hours can be slow, so families here often favour tutors who live on this side.

A tutor based in Pynthorumkhrah or Nongmynsong can usually teach in both, and the nearer parts of Mawlai are within easy reach of tutors from Jaiaw and the central wards. NXTutors builds the shortlist in that order, closest first: tutors in the zone, then those who travel here, then elsewhere in Shillong, then online tutors for subjects with no local match. Two or three tutors are offered per request, each tutor's fee shows before booking, and the first class is a free demo. Changing tutor later carries no charge, and a home tutor can be paired with an online one where a subject needs it.
faqs: Which neighbourhoods does the Mawlai & Pynthorumkhrah zone cover?

Three: Mawlai, Pynthorumkhrah and Nongmynsong. Mawlai is large and has several localities of its own, Pynthorumkhrah includes Langkyrding, and Nongmynsong sits between Pynthorumkhrah and Rynjah. Each has an area page on NXTutors showing the tutors closest to it, which is a useful first look before you send a request.
Why do families on this side prefer tutors who live nearby?

Because crossing Shillong at busy hours can be slow. A tutor already living in Mawlai, Pynthorumkhrah, Nongmynsong or Mawpat can keep a weekday evening slot reliably, which matters most in exam months when those slots fill quickly. Tutors from Jaiaw also reach the nearer parts of Mawlai.
What should a Mawlai family tell a tutor before the first class?

Which Mawlai locality you live in and the nearest bus stop, such as Mawiong, Nonglum or Mawlai Pump. Mawlai is spread out over several parts, and many homes sit on slopes reached by steps, so mention those too and where a two-wheeler can be left.
How many tutors will NXTutors send for a request from this zone?

Two or three, chosen nearest first. NXTutors looks at tutors in the zone, then those who travel here, then the rest of Shillong, then online tutors. Each profile shows the tutor's own fee, and the first class you book is a free demo, so you can compare in practice.
